source.limitations: Transcribed from the Van Wert County Health Department Septage Haulers PDF (SEPTAGE-HAULERS-6-9-26.pdf; footer 06/09/2026; Page 1 prints 9 TOTAL), linked as Septage Haulers from the Household Sewage Treatment Systems page (https://vanwertcountyhealth.org/household-sewage-treatment-systems/). Publisher block on the PDF: 1179 WESTWOOD DRIVE, VAN WERT, OH 45891, Phone 1-419-238-0808, Fax 1-419-238-9571. HDIS text-layer file (Title HDIS PDF, Author HDIS Sewage Treatment, CreationDate 2026-06-09 18:22:35 UTC, 1 page, page rotation 0). The archived .txt is the pdftotext -layout extract and still shows the printed leading hyphens. Spellings kept as printed, including HORSES SANITATION SERVICE LLC with no apostrophe, GROTHOUSE PLBG. & HTG. INC. with the abbreviations and periods, GRIER'S POWER DIGGING LLC and MIKE'S SANITATION, INC. with apostrophes, BLUFFTON AERATION SERVICE, INC. with the comma and INC., and FISCHER PLUMBING & HEATING, OHIO SANITARY SERVICES, and TRESSLER PLUMBING with no LLC suffix. Street and city lines are joined with a space as printed. No local registration numbers on this PDF. Phones are shown as printed apart from a stray leading hyphen the HDIS export adds on eight numbers; no digits were added or changed, and BLUFFTON AERATION SERVICE, INC. stays 1-419-358-9673. ODH statewide bond status is not on this PDF (marked unknown). The Sewage Treatment System Installers PDF and the Service Providers PDF on the parent page were not transcribed and were not merged. The ODH statewide septage-hauler bond list was not merged. A septage hauler registration is not a service-provider inspection credential. Appearance is not an endorsement. Verify with the Van Wert County Health Department and ODH before you hire.
